items.Sentence: The components of the treatment system at the Facility include: • two bar screens;
The components of the treatment system at the Facility include: • four aerated grit chambers;
The Facility provides full nitrification and denitrification for nitrogen removal
The components of the treatment system at the Facility include: • four secondary clarifiers;
The Facility ... uses tertiary filtration followed by ultraviolet light (UV) for disinfection. The components of the treatment system at the Facility include: • six sand filters;
The Facility ... uses tertiary filtration followed by ultraviolet light (UV) for disinfection. The components of the treatment system at the Facility include: • three UV disinfection channels;

The Facility includes three earthen-lined storage basins (approximately 31.8 acres with a combined capacity of 65.1 million gallons) that provide effluent storage capacity for a 100-year rainfall event and are used for storing partially treated effluent for short periods or by storing only tertiary treated effluent.

An additional earthen-lined emergency storage basin (approximately 10 acres with a capacity of 20.6 million gallons) is used to store influent that could compromise the plant process, as well as secondary effluent or tertiary filter effluent from plant upsets.
Solids handling facilities include three centrifuges for dewatering.
Solids collected from the primary and secondary clarifiers are sent to three centrifuges for dewatering.
Biosolids are disposed at the Western Regional Sanitary Landfill.
